topic: Sending a cease-contact letter vs enduring collector harassment (Roy vs Hattie)

scenes.narration: One simple letter can legally stop a collector from ever calling you again. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a ringing phone crossed out, comic burst banner reads STOP CALLING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Roy and Hattie each get ten harassing collector calls every single day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man roy and woman hattie covering their ears, phones buzzing with TEN CALLS A DAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The law lets them demand the collector stop contacting them entirely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing law book open to a page titled CEASE CONTACT RIGHT, a wooden gavel resting on it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hattie just keeps answering, arguing, and crying through every call.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman hattie exhausted on the phone late at night, a wall calendar full of CALL marks, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The calls reach her job and her neighbors hear her name.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman hattie embarrassed at her desk as a phone rings, coworkers glancing over, comic banner reads CALLED AT WORK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Roy writes a cease contact letter and keeps a dated copy.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man roy at a desk writing a letter labeled CEASE CONTACT, a photocopy stamped with the date beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He mails it certified so he has proof it was received.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man roy at a post office handing over an envelope stamped CERTIFIED MAIL, a receipt in his hand, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Roy logs every later call as evidence of illegal harassment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man roy writing in a notebook labeled CALL LOG, a phone screen showing recorded times, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hattie endures months of stress, lost sleep, and constant fear.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman hattie sleepless at night, dark circles, phones glowing around her bed, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Roy's letter forces the calls to stop within just one week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man roy relaxed at home, a silent phone with a banner reads NO MORE CALLS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He even wins damages when the collector breaks the law again.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man roy smiling holding a check stamped DAMAGES AWARDED, a gavel on the bench beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Send a written cease contact letter and log every call. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads CEASE CONTACT IN WRITING, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
